about: A fold is a function of the points it folds: the digest each leaf was observed at, the lines that stand, and the receipts the store keeps.
Two trees whose points have one digest have one fold, so the fold is taken once and read after that.
It is kept as a blob in the store and announced by one claim, never as a folder of files or a key on the clock.

cases.name: the same points answer twice
cases.announced: fold/<key> by=<the signer the lock admits for folds>
cases.reading: read the blob the claim names
cases.missing: REFUSE naming the blob and the claim
cases.forked: two signers, two blobs, one key: a fork, never the nearer one
